review_summary: CSR map helper is pinned by source SHA and loaded after G0/cold preflight. Registration follows system_reset_stop and precedes controller.deploy; attempted owned mapping is cleared before XSDB session disconnect. The existing helper bounds the mapping to the reviewed implemented-XSA CSR window.
Interface parser accepts the current title version token and requires exactly one version with the interface-specific prefix; tests cover duplicate and wrong-prefix rejection.

Host schedule sends weights, then repeat stress, then all 109 corpus rows. Stress consumes frames 0..999 and corpus rows start at frame 1000; sequence and epoch advance through the existing transport checks. The first failing stress request latches failure before any corpus request.

The new preparation has 109 rows; acceptance.validate_plan passed against every referenced input/reference. Parsed JSON differs from the original preparation only at source_sha256; its path is unchanged and its SHA matches the current board acceptance source. No model inference was rerun.

The two default-unpinned preflight tests explicitly set G0 path/SHA to None, preserving the intended fail-before-runtime gate when production constants are now pinned; the corrected 35-test suite passed independently after that test-only correction.
acceptance_limitations: PASS is limited to the four reviewed files, new preparation binding and G0 receipt.

Before launch, root must pin G0_BASIS_PATH and G0_BASIS_SHA256 to this receipt and update model config runner_source SHA; these two constant/config bindings do not change the reviewed runtime behavior.
No claim is made that repeat1000, the full 109 corpus, G3, G4, or G5 has run or passed.
